records.food_material: Analytical cell-wall pectin fractions from the thirteen apple cultivars studied by Liu et al.

food_evidence.statement: The primary composition study isolated and characterised pectin from apple materials.

records.preparation: Cultivar-specific extracted analytical fractions; not a standardised pectin dose
limitations: Pectin structure, purified preparation, donor community and enriched culture medium affect interpretation. Pascale is secondary synthesis; Bang is bounded primary culture evidence. Whole apples are not equivalent to the tested citrus preparation; no human brain or clinical benefit is established.
Qualitative supply only; retain cultivar, fraction and food-matrix variation. No per-100-g pectin amount inferred from total fibre; whole fruit is not purified citrus pectin.

records.food_material: Commercial POM Wonderful 100% pomegranate juice batches assayed in Singh et al.

food_evidence.statement: The primary human study assayed ellagic acid and punicalagins in the administered juice matrix.

records.preparation: Chilled commercial juice; not whole-fruit or other-product equivalence
limitations: Conversion depends on microbial community and may stop at intermediates. This does not imply universal conversion, increased mitochondrial function or benefit.
Product and batch dependent. No urolithin A was detected in the juice; microbial conversion is variable. No whole-fruit quantity, ordinary-serving efficacy or brain benefit inferred.
records.missing_ontology_edge: pomegranates → ellagic-acid [Commercial POM Wonderful 100% pomegranate juice batches assayed in Singh et al.; Chilled commercial juice; not whole-fruit or other-product equivalence]
records.pm_mission: Enable microbial activation of dietary polyphenols into bioactive metabolites.
records.biological_operation: Immediate microbial substrate for the assessed urolithin-generation pathway.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Gordonibacter cultures produced intermediate urolithins from ellagic acid.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Pure strains did not produce final urolithin A/B; community completion is conditional.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Assayed pomegranate juice contained ellagic acid/punicalagins; urolithin exposure varied across people.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Commercial juice matrix; not equivalent to whole pomegranate or walnuts, predictable urolithin yield, mitochondrial or brain benefit.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary full text, investigational product assays and conversion results.
